description.p: PixelCraft is a pixel art and frame-by-frame animation editor that works offline and keeps your projects on your computer.

ul.li: Pencil, brush, eraser, shapes, fill, gradient with ordered dithering and bitmap text
Layers with groups, blend modes and opacity
Timeline with onion skin, tags and linked cels
Palettes (GPL, HEX, JASC, ACT), color reduction and analysis
Tiles with seamless preview and tileset export with a Tiled map
Export to PNG, GIF, JPEG, WebP, BMP, spritesheets and PNG sequences

description.p: PixelCraft é um editor de pixel art e animação quadro a quadro que funciona offline e guarda seus projetos no seu computador.

Pixel-perfect pencil, shading ink, on-canvas transform with RotSprite, animation tags, opening and saving .aseprite files, indexed colour mode, colour adjustments, APNG and SVG export, pen pressure, TTF fonts and rulers.
